hr.hero.title: Gradim SaaS proizvode i marketplace platforme, od ideje do produkcije.
hr.hero.sub: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe. Opseg i cijena dogovoreni prije početka.
hr.clients.title: S kim radimo
hr.about.p: Ja sam Neven. Gradim SaaS proizvode i marketplace platforme od početka do kraja, s najviše pažnje na arhitekturu, bazu podataka i back-end, jer se tu odlučuje hoće li proizvod izdržati stvarne korisnike. Dolazim iz elektrotehnike, a od 2025. izrađujem web softver za osnivače i mala poduzeća u Europi. Prvo napišem plan i specifikaciju, podijelim posao u faze i dogovorim opseg i cijenu prije početka.
hr.services.h2: Proizvodi i sustavi, ne samo stranice.
hr.services.note: Od ideje do produkcije. Jedna odgovornost
hr.services.c1_p: Alati za unutarnje procese: cijeli tim radi u istom sustavu. Zalihe, narudžbe, evidencija — sve u pregledniku, bez Excela i improvizacije.
hr.services.c2_p: Portali i sustavi gdje tvoji klijenti sami rade: rezervacije, ponude, pristup podacima. Manje tvog vremena, više njihove samostalnosti.
hr.services.c3_p: Prva verzija proizvoda za testiranje ideje na tržištu: MVP, landing s funkcijom, manji alati. Građeno da brzo vidiš radi li koncept.
hr.process.s1_p: Ciljevi, opseg i ključne stavke. Sve na stolu prije nego krenemo.
hr.process.s2_p: Tehnička strategija i plan. Znaš što se gradi i zašto.
hr.process.s3_p: Vidiš radni sustav brzo. Dorade dok ne bude točno kako treba.
hr.testi.ivan_q: „Tražili smo prilagođeno rješenje i jasan proces. Suradnja je bila transparentna i bez stresa, s redovitim updateima. Zadovoljni smo i rezultatom i isporukom. Preporučujem.”
hr.testi.vedran_q: „Prije početka projekta imali smo zastarjelu web tehnologiju koja nije jasno prikazivala našu ponudu ni vizualni identitet objekta. Proces suradnje bio je vrlo profesionalan, brz i konkretan – komunikacija je bila jasna, a svi prijedlozi i dorade odrađeni su u dogovorenim rokovima. Rezultatom smo izuzetno zadovoljni jer stranica sada izgleda moderno, pregledno i u potpunosti predstavlja Palazzinu Burjaki na način koji smo željeli.”
hr.testi.cta_p: Trenutno imam kapacitet za nove klijente - od startupova do ustaljenih tvrtki. Ako imate problem koji treba rješenje, javi se.
hr.faq.a1: Custom web aplikacije i sustavi: unutarnji alati za tvrtke, portali za klijente, MVP-ovi. Definiramo scope, dogovorimo cijenu, isporučimo. Uključeno 6 mjeseci popravljanja grešaka.
hr.faq.a2: Manji MVP-evi i stranice obično traju jedan do dva tjedna. Veći proizvodi, poput portala za članove ili marketplacea, traju nekoliko tjedana, a isporučuju se u etapama. Rok se dogovara prije početka.
hr.faq.a3: Dogovara se prije početka na temelju opsega, kao fiksna cijena ili po satu, ovisno o projektu. Bez skrivenih troškova.
hr.faq.a4: Popravljanje grešaka (bug fix) uključeno 6 mjeseci nakon predaje. Nije redizajn ili nove značajke, nego ispravljanje onoga što ne radi kako treba.
hr.faq.a5: Većinu projekata vodim sam (Neven). Kad treba, angažiram suradnike; ti imaš jednu kontaktnu osobu i jednu fakturu.
hr.faq.a6: Pošalji upit putem obrasca ili na email. Odgovaram unutar 24 sata s procjenom roka i cijene. Ako se dogovorimo, krećemo.
hr.contact.call_p: 5 minuta razgovora vrijedi više od 10 mailova.
hr.contact.lead: Opišite što trebate. Odgovaram unutar 24 sata s konkretnom procjenom roka i cijene.
hr.contact.examples: Npr.: 'Trebam sustav za praćenje zaliha gdje vlasnik i zaposlenici vide real-time stanje.' Ili: 'Želimo portal gdje klijenti sami generiraju ponude.'
hr.contact.when_ph: npr. jutro 9–11, ili slobodan danas poslije 14h
hr.contact.msg_ph: Opišite problem ili ideju. Što treba rješiti, tko će koristiti sustav, imate li rok?
hr.js.ok: Poruka je uspješno poslana. Javit ćemo se u roku 24 sata.
hr.js.err: Došlo je do greške. Pokušajte ponovno ili nam se javite putem e-maila.
hr.footer.tag: Custom softver, web aplikacije, unutarnji sustavi. Od ideje do produkcije. Brzo i bez komplikacija.

en.hero.title: I build SaaS products and marketplaces, from idea to production.
en.hero.sub: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe. Scope and price agreed before I start.
en.clients.title: Who we work with
en.about.p: I’m Neven. I build SaaS products and marketplaces end to end, with most of my attention on architecture, the database and the backend, because that is where products either hold up under real users or fall apart. I come from an electrical background, and since 2025 I build web software for founders and small businesses in Europe. I write the plan and spec first, split the work into phases, and agree scope and price before I start.
en.services.h2: Products and systems, not just websites.
en.services.note: From idea to production. One point of responsibility
en.services.c1_p: Tools for internal processes: the whole team works in the same system. Stock, orders, records — all in the browser, with no Excel and no improvising.
en.services.c1_l3: • One system for the whole team
en.services.c2_p: Portals and systems where your clients work on their own: bookings, quotes, access to data. Less of your time, more of their independence.
en.services.c3_p: A first version of the product to test the idea on the market: an MVP, a landing page with a function, smaller tools. Built so you can quickly see whether the concept works.
en.process.s1_p: Goals, scope and key items. Everything on the table before we start.
en.process.s2_p: Technical strategy and plan. You know what is being built and why.
en.process.s3_p: You see a working system quickly. Refinements until it is exactly right.
en.process.s5_p: Deploy, documentation, and 6 months of support included.
en.testi.ivan_q: “We were looking for a custom solution and a clear process. The collaboration was transparent and stress-free, with regular updates. We are happy with both the result and the delivery. I recommend it.”
en.testi.vedran_q: “Before the project we had outdated web technology that did not clearly present our offer or the visual identity of the property. The collaboration was very professional, fast and concrete – communication was clear, and all suggestions and refinements were done within the agreed deadlines. We are extremely happy with the result because the website now looks modern, clear and fully presents Palazzina Burjaki the way we wanted.”
en.testi.cta_p: I currently have capacity for new clients – from startups to established companies. If you have a problem that needs a solution, get in touch.
en.faq.a1: Custom web applications and systems: internal tools for companies, client portals, MVPs. We define the scope, agree on the price and deliver. 6 months of bug fixing included.
en.faq.q2: How long does a project usually take?
en.faq.a2: Smaller MVPs and websites usually take one to two weeks. Larger products, such as member portals or marketplaces, take several weeks and are delivered in stages. The deadline is agreed before the start.
en.faq.a3: It is agreed before the start based on the scope, as a fixed price or hourly, depending on the project. No hidden costs.
en.faq.q4: What does “6 months of support” mean?
en.faq.a4: Bug fixing is included for 6 months after handover. It is not a redesign or new features, but fixing whatever does not work as it should.
en.faq.q5: Do you work alone or with a team?
en.faq.a5: I lead most projects myself (Neven). When needed, I bring in collaborators; you have one point of contact and one invoice.
en.faq.a6: Send an inquiry through the form or by email. I reply within 24 hours with an estimate of the deadline and price. If we agree, we get started.
en.contact.call_p: A 5-minute conversation is worth more than 10 emails.
en.contact.h2: Do you have a problem that needs a solution?
en.contact.lead: Describe what you need. I reply within 24 hours with a concrete estimate of the deadline and price.
en.contact.examples: E.g.: 'I need a stock tracking system where the owner and employees see the real-time status.' Or: 'We want a portal where clients generate quotes themselves.'
en.contact.when_ph: e.g. morning 9–11, or free today after 2 pm
en.contact.msg_ph: Describe the problem or idea. What needs to be solved, who will use the system, do you have a deadline?
en.js.ok: Your message was sent successfully. We will get back to you within 24 hours.
